          Research Assistant saysHere is the key takeaway of the document, based on the author's abstract.

          Complex systems are best understood by leveraging both their anatomical and effective structures, as demonstrated through various applications in network controllability and clustering frameworks.

          Additional topics discussed include:

          • Network controllability
          • Biochemical regulation
          • Clustering frameworks in neuroscience and social science
